CRC8 is an Arduino-friendly class implementing an 8-bit CRC calculator. It supports configurable polynomial, initial value, XOR-out, and input/output bit-reversal. Methods allow incremental feeding of bytes or arrays, retrieving the current CRC, resetting/restarting, and tracking processed byte count. Some legacy/deprecated aliases are present. Construction and behavior details are clear, but actual algorithmic implementation resides in the source file.

CRC12 is a configurable Arduino-friendly class to compute 12-bit CRC checksums. It supports setting the polynomial, initial value, final XOR, and input/output bit-reversal. Methods allow incremental feeding of bytes or buffers, restarting/reseting parameters, getting the current CRC, and querying processed byte count. Deprecated aliases are present for backward compatibility. The exact meanings of CRC12_POLYNOME/INITIAL/XOR_OUT/REV_IN/REV_OUT and the crc_size_t typedef are referenced from included headers and not defined here.

CRC16 calculator class for Arduino-style environments. It maintains CRC parameters (polynomial, initial value, XOR-out, input/output bit reversal) and an internal running CRC and count. Use add() to feed bytes or buffers, calc() to read the current CRC, restart()/reset() to reinitialize. Deprecated aliases are provided for backward compatibility. Ownership is standalone; no external owner fields are defined here. Details of crc_size_t come from included headers and are not defined in this file.

Class implementing a configurable CRC-32 calculator for Arduino-style environments. Supports setting polynome, initial value, xor-out, and bit order (reverse in/out). Provides methods to reset/restart the state, add bytes or buffers (optionally with a yielding period), and compute the final CRC. Deprecated helpers are kept for backward compatibility. Internal state tracks the current CRC and processed byte count.

Configurable CRC-64 calculator for Arduino/C++. Supports setting polynome, initial value, final XOR, and input/output bit reversal. Methods allow incremental updates with bytes or buffers, restarting, and retrieving the current CRC and processed length. Some legacy methods are marked deprecated. Note: crc_size_t and CRC64_* macros are referenced from included headers and not defined here.

Type alias for the size/index type used by the CRC library. It resolves at compile time to CRC_CUSTOM_SIZE if defined by the user, otherwise to uint16_t on AVR targets, or to size_t on other platforms. Intended to standardize the size type across platforms for CRC-related operations. Underlying type is platform- or configuration-dependent.

CRC-32 calculator class optimized for Arduino. Provides incremental CRC computation via add() over bytes or buffers, restart() to reinitialize, calc() to get the current CRC value, and count() to report processed byte count. Internal state includes a 32-bit CRC accumulator and a processed-byte counter. Specific polynomial and parameters are presumably defined by included headers; details are not present here.
